messages.subject: Re: A problem running Rqtl
parts:
The problem seems to be that

which(phenotype==pheno)

is maybe returning a missing value.

Also, scanqtl is for multi-dimensional scanning, and so pos whould generally be a list of intervals rather than single points.

I'd recommending trying fitqtl for fitting a specific multiple-qtl model

qtl <- makeqtl(RIL, chr=chr, pos=pos)
out <- fitqtl(RIL, phono.col=5, qtl=qtl)
summary(out)

karl
